sanskrit: ityevaṃ lakṣaṇairyuktā nārī puṃsā vivarjayetabhiniryāya saṃyuktaṃ tālavindālasaṃyutametallakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ gāndharvaṃ samudāhṛtamtaddoṣasamanārthāya snapanaṃ pañcaviṃśatiḥśuddhanṛttādinā pūrvaṃ niśāyāmadhivāsayetśayanaṃ kalpayettatra ajātīni ca kalpayetśāyayetkautukaṃ badhvā svarṇasūtrantu sūtrayetmaunako vādyakañcaiva niśāyāmadhivāsayettadardhe sthaṇḍilaiścaiva tadardhaiśca tilairapisa kūrcān sapidhānāṃśca sa vastraiḥpallavairyutamprātaḥkāle samuddhṛtya śaucācamanapūrvakamnavabhiḥ kalaśaisthāpya dīkṣāmantramanusmaranhṛdayena tu mantreṇa puṣpaṃ śirasi vinyasettannāmaṃ vācayennityaṃ rudranārī yathākramamvighneśañca namaskṛtvā phalapuṣpahavirdadetgandhapuṣpahavirdatvā tāṃbūlañca pradāpayettataḥ prakaranārīṇāṃ praviśenmaṇṭapaṃ pratisāyaṃkāle baliṃ dadyāt maṇṭapasyādhidevatātanmadhye mukhaṃ sthāpya gandhapuṣpādinā'rcayetnandikeśvaramabhyarcya gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramāttṛtīyaṃ vaṃśatālākhyaṃ oṅkāragaṇamudāhṛtamṣaṣṭhakaṃ vādyakairyuktaṃ saptamaṃ puṣpamokṣamamdaśamaṃ nṛttasaṃpūrṇaṃ ityete nṛttalakṣaṇamdevasyottare deśe nṛttasya sukhamāsthitaunardako mardakaiścaiva dakṣiṇena tu saṃsthitau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00250 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: * * * * * * * ṇāṃ paridhitrayameva casamidhā sadyamantreṇa ājyaṃ vā'nena mantrakaiḥtilamīśānamantreṇa sarṣapaṃ kavacena tupāyasaṃ gulakhaṇḍañca śivamantreṇa hūyatetryaṃbakena mantreṇa kautukantu naṭeśvaramkautukaṃ astradevānāṃ mṛgaṃ vādyantu kautukamsumuhūrte viśeṣeṇa bandhayetkautukaṃ hṛdānṛttagītañca vādyantu purāṇaṃ kathitaṃ kramātnivedayettato mantrī tāṃbūlantu nivedayetchatrañca cāmarañcaiva darpaṇaṃ darśayetkramātnavavastrairalaṅkṛtya kautukaṃ pūrvavatkramātśvetapuṣpairalaṅkṛtya śvetacandanalepitamsthaṇḍilaprabhasaṃyuktaṃ biṃbaprabhasamanvitamdhūpadīpasamāyuktaṃ nīrājanaṃ viśeṣataḥnṛpatī bhaktajanānāntu śeṣabhasmantu dāpayetācāryasnānamevantu pratisnānaṃ samācaretdevāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kuryādaṣṭadroṇaiśca śālibhiḥsthālikā taṇḍulaiḥ pūrya kṛṣṇagandhasamanvitamśaṅkhaṃ dundubhinirghoṣaiḥ stotramaṅgalavācakaiḥdevasannidhisaṃprāpte homaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥpuṇyāhaṃ vācayeddhīmān homaṃ kṛtvā vicakṣaṇaḥhomānte kṛṣṇagandhaṃ syāt lepayettu naṭeśvarambrāhmaṇān bhojayettatra svasvasūtra samanvitammūlaberasugandhaṃ syāt parivārasamanvitamcaturvedaṃ japaṃ kṛtvā bhūsurān bhojayetkramāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00250 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: geyantu darśanaṃ prāpya kanyādarśanakaṃ bhavetgandhadvāreti mantreṇa tāḍayettu viśeṣataḥpuṣpāñjaliṃ namaskṛtvā vādyakān tāḍayetkramātnandimantrasamuccārya mṛdavādyantu tāḍayetjhallarīmukhañcaiva paṭahaṃ mardalaṃ tathāevaṃ saptavidhaṃ kuryāt mahānāṭyaṃ tathaiva cadhūpadīpasamāyuktaṃ nīrājanaṃ viśeṣataḥchatrañca cāmarau caiva vyajanantu kramātsudhīḥsarvabhaktajanānāntu sarveṣāṃ gandhameva camahāhavirnivedyasyāttāṃbūlantu nivedayetsarvapuṣpairalaṅkṛtya sarvayoṣasamanvitampuṣpaprabhasamāyuktaṃ citraprabhasamanvitamsaptagṛhaṃ tataḥ kuryāt praviśyāsthānamaṇṭapamnīrājanaṃ tataḥ kuryāt bhasmantu dāpayetkramāttāṃbūlaṃ dāpayitvā tu darpaṇaṃ darśayetkramātsnapanaṃ kārayitvā tu paścācca pañcaviṃśatiḥtālacūrṇaṃ sakṛccūrṇaṃ udakaṃ grāhya buddhimānpuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra vedadhvani samanvitamśvetacandanasaṃyuktaṃ karpūrameva miśritamhavirnivedayeddhīmān tāṃbūlaṃ tatra kārayetśivāgre maṇṭapaṃ kuryāt viśedāsthānamaṇṭapampaiśācanṛttasaṃyuktaṃ mahānāṭakasaṃyutamsarvābharaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sarvamālyavibhūṣitamgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt praviśetālakaṃ kuru?ārātrikasamāyuktaṃ bhasmaṃ datvā viśeṣataḥ

sanskrit: śeṣabhasmaṃ tataḥ kuryāt bhūpatiśca viśeṣataḥnālikerasamāyuktaṃ panasaṃ kadalīphalammṛgayātrāṃ samārabhya pūrvarātrādhivāsayetvājiyajñāstadante tu gaccha yatra gajastathākecit khaḍgadharāścaiva kecitparaśuddharastathāyuddhārambhe tathāssarve śīghraṃ gacchetsamākulamsarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ vanayātrasamanvitamgaurīcaṇḍeśanandīśo mahākālo vṛṣastathāpradoṣakālasamaye tīrthādhivāsanaṃ tathātaṃ madhye lalitaṃ kuryāt tripādī tatra vinyasetumāskandeśvaraścaiva mantradevasamanvitamkautukaṃ bandhayeddhīmān umāskandeśvaraṃ tathātryaṃbakena mantreṇa rakṣāsūtraṃ subandhayetnadītaṭākamudreṇa astratīrthasamanvitamsthaṇḍilaṃ tatra kurvīta sthāpayennavakuṃbhakānsaptatālavidhaṃ kuryādācāryaśśiṣyasaṃyutamgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt praviśedālayaṃ pratiprātaḥkāle samārabhya avabhṛthasnānamuttamamgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryādumāskandeśvaraṃ tathācūrṇotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryānmaṇṭapāgraviśeṣataḥtanmadhye sthaṇḍilaṃ kuryāllūkhalaṃ musalena tuvastradūrvāsamāyuktaṃ darbhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ paristaretrudrakanyāsamāyuktaṃ snānaṃ kṛtvā viśeṣataḥdhūpadīpasamāyuktaṃ puṣpahaste pradāpayetśaṅkhaghoṣasamāyuktaṃ sarvavādyasamanvitam

sanskrit: tailadūrvākṣatān puṣpaiḥ kūrcamantraiva vinyasetpuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra ghṛtaśīrorpaṇaṃ tathāumāskandeśvarañcaiva astrabherīntu tailakamdhūpadīpasamāyuktamārātrikasamanvitamdarpaṇaṃ darśayetkṛtvā cāmaraṃ vyajanaṃ tathāpratimāmastradevānāṃ rajanīcūrṇamastakamtailalastraṃ cūrṇapātraṃ astradeva samanvitamprākāre tu pradakṣiṇyāṃ śīghraṃ gacchetsamākulamyakovādyanṛttaṃ vā gaṇikābhissamanvitamparistareṇa bhājānāmarcayetkalaśannavasaptatālavidhaṃ proktaṃ ācāryaśśiṣya eva vāgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt praviśedālayaṃ tataḥyāge saṃpūjayettatra pūrṇāhutimathācaretgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryācchivāgre maṇṭapaṃ tathāvāgīśvarasya devānāmapi bāhye pradakṣiṇamumāskandeśvarañcaiva snapanaṃ tatra kārayetdevāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā aṣṭadroṇaiśca śālibhiḥśuddhavastraparīdhānaṃ śvetamālāvibhūṣitamdhūpadīpau samāropya nīrājanaṃ viśeṣataḥlājapuṣpaṃ gṛhītvā tu brāhmaṇāṃ svastivācakaiḥyāgopacāraṃ saṅgṛhya vastrahemāṅgulīyakaiḥdhvajadevaṃ samabhyarcya mudgānnantu nivedayetbherīghoṣasamāyuktaṃ sarvālaṅkārameva cacaṇḍeśasthānasaṃyuktaṃ vastrairābharaṇairyutamhomānte tu nivedyaṃ syāt tāṃbūlantu nivedayet

sanskrit: annaliṅgasamāyuktaṃ balipātrasamanvitammaunavratadharāssarve sandhidevān visarjayetgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryānmahāpīṭhe baliṃ kṣipetgaurīyāgamahaṃ vakṣye pūrvarātrādhivāsayetgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ kuryāt bhaktotsavamanantaretsarvadāridryanāśa syāt rājño vijayavarddhanamutsavasya viśeṣeṇa prāyaścittaṃ vidhīyatedhvajasya dhvajadaṇḍasya paṭasya tu viśeṣataḥhṛdayena śataṃ hutvā snāpanaṃ pañcagavyakaiḥhomadravyavihīne tu hṛdayena śatāhutiḥhṛnmantreṇa śataṃ hutvā sarvaśāntinimittataḥśūlasya patanañcaiva sarveṣāñca śatāhutiḥkṛtvā tu snapanaṃ tatra mūlamantreṇa hūyatetithivāramuhūrte ca kālāpekṣāṃ na kārayetpratidikkarma sarveṣāṃ pūrvavatkārayedbudhaḥkalahe rudhirasrāve agnidaṇḍe tathaiva casūtikāmṛtasaṃsparśe darśane tu viśeṣataḥśāntihomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā pañcagavyena prokṣayetpūrvavattu dhvajārohaṃ punarutsavamācaretpatitairvyādhipīḍyāṃśca mūlādirudhirasravampuṇyāhaṃ vācayettatra asya nārīkriyā bhavetpunarvādyaṃ samāropya pavamānaṃ samuccaransarvalokahitārthāya sarvaprāṇihitāvahamsvasthāpanapratiṣṭhā ca pratiṣṭhāpañcabhedakaḥsautaṃ sthāpanasiddhiñca jīrṇoddhāraṃ susaṃsthitam

sanskrit: dviguṇottarasaṃvargo bhavediṣṭapramāṇataḥkaṇṭhavargo bhavetkoṭī bhujāvargasamāsataḥsarvavargastu bhujākoṭyāstadardhadvibhujā bhavetparidhīvṛtta viṣkaṃbhapādaghnaṃ phalakulahataṃghanammaṇṭapena tu sādṛśya ṣaḍbhāgantu ṣaḍaśravatbāhuṃ nyastvā suvargeṇa phalavargasuvargajamicchāyā phalamāśritya pramāṇoktaphalaṃ nayetśrepisaṅke valādīni yāgne yāne daśāni caātmānamiti vijñāya māyādīn lakṣayetkramātvaro'ṣṭanā ca saṃśodhya śubhe vāstuṃ samārabhetvistārāyāmasaṃyuktaṃ rāśirvā'tha nirīkṣayetsaguṇavahnibhiḥ sūtraiḥ bhaktaśeṣāvyavasthayāsaptaviṃśati bhaktairvā vasvayustatphalaṃ smṛtamliṅgamānavaśādgehaṃ trividhaṃ vakṣyate punaḥdrāvile drāvilamityuktaṃ trividhaṃ prāsādamīritamsātvikaṃ nāgaraṃ proktaṃ rājasaṃ drāvilaṃ bhavetnāgaraṃ puvimānena liṅgasya prāsādakaṃ kurutrairāśikena liṅgasya śayanaṃ prāsādamucyatepadmabandhāttu śayanaṃ jñeyatrāpi bhedayuknāgaraṃ dvijamityuktaṃ drāvilaṃ kṣatriyasya tunāgaraṃ drāvilākhyañca vesarañcādhi devatāmevaṃ prāsādamevoktaṃ sañcindādīni bhedayuksañcikasthāpanaṃ proktaṃ sañcitāvṛttasañcikampratibandhatrayaṃ proktaṃ jāgratsvapnantu yogakṛtsvapnāvasthā ṛjucchāyā trividhaṃ prāsādalakṣaṇam
